title: Summary after appending a Boolean value
statement: For a Boolean list $u$, define its summary to be absent when $u$ is empty, its sole entry when it has length one, and false when it has length at least two. Combining two optional Boolean values returns the one present if the other is absent, and returns false if both are present. The summary of $u$ after appending the optional Boolean value $e$ (when present) is the combination of the summary of $u$ with $e$.
